title: Health Economic Model Description
text: models compare two strategies, called “intervention” “comparator” treatment metastatic breast cancer. used yearly cycle time horizon 30 years. apply half cycle correction. “intervention” strategy incurs treatment costs reduces transition probability “progression free” (PF) “progressed disease” (PD) compared “comparator” strategy HSTM reduces probability progression death PSM. addition, chance experiencing adverse events intervention strategy incurs additional costs utility decrement beginning models. “comparator” strategy entails “nothing” incur treatment costs adverse event-related utility decrement costs.

text: probabilistic analysis 10,000 iterations performed Monte Carlo analysis using models.
